params.value: ($1), who needs the tutorial? Click on the players or select from the middle.

preset.text:
Everyone is dealt a rank at the table, from the Great Emperor at the top to the Great Serf at the bottom. Your goal every round is simple: get rid of your whole hand first.

Low numbers are powerful. The single 1 is the Emperor; there are twelve 12s and they are Peasants.

The leader plays any number of cards of the same rank — one 7, or three 9s. Everyone after must play the same number of cards at a lower rank, or pass.

So three 9s can be beaten by three 4s, but never by two 4s.

Once everyone else passes, the trick is over and whoever played last leads the next one.

The two Jesters are wild — play them alongside real cards to pad out a set. On their own they are the worst rank in the game.

Before each round the Serfs hand their best cards up to the Emperors, who send any cards back down. Unless someone holding both Jesters calls a Revolution — then nobody pays.

Go out first and you rule next round. Go out last and you serve.

preset.title: REVOLUTION?
preset.question: You hold both Jesters. Call a Revolution and cancel this round's taxes?
